### Summary

The change is correct. `ControlBarWindow.raise()` checks `wanted`, and `bar.hide()` is now called when a countdown is abandoned. I checked `raiseFloating` in `recording-hub.ts` (line 461) and the callers of `bar.show`/`bar.hide`: a raise that arrives before `bar.show` is skipped, but a bar shown later lands on top anyway. The only gap is that the bubble's new visibility guard has no test.
